The bank "Интернешънъл Асет Банк" is represented by the medium gray line, not the light gray one (which represents "Д Банк").
The line for "Интернешънъл Асет Банк" (medium gray) starts at approximately 70%, not 50%.
The line for "Интернешънъл Асет Банк" peaks at approximately 100% in the year 2011, not 2009.
